hotels.title: Historic Budapest Grandeur in the Heart of the City
hotels.description: Set within a magnificent Art Nouveau palace on Budapest’s Grand Boulevard, this heritage address pairs stained glass, sweeping arches and period detailing with polished contemporary interiors. Blaha Lujza tér Metro Station is moments away, placing the Hungarian State Opera, Dohány Street Synagogue and the boutiques of Andrássy Avenue within easy reach. At the hotel’s Palace Restaurant, Hungarian classics and international dishes are served beneath a striking glass roof in a belle-époque setting. New York Café’s gilded salons are a short stroll away, and the Jewish Quarter’s ruin bars, speciality coffee houses and late-night bistros unfold just beyond the boulevard

hotels.title: A Design-Led Stay Steps from Budapest’s Opera House
hotels.description: Set on lively Nagymezo Street in Budapest’s theatre district, this design-led retreat places you steps from the Hungarian State Opera House and the grand boutiques of Andrassy Avenue. Contemporary rooms pair sleek lines with plush textures, creating a polished base in one of the city’s most cultured quarters. Start the evening with Hungarian flavours and refined plates at the hotel’s restaurant, then slip into the chic bar for cocktails beneath striking interiors. St Stephen’s Basilica, the Danube promenade and the ruin bars of the Jewish Quarter are all within easy reach
